description: The chart illustrates the distribution of various categories across different groups, with the horizontal axis representing the categories and the vertical axis representing the values. The horizontal axis is labeled with three category names: "Decreasing", "Spindle", and "Bottleneck", in that order, and the bars are grouped under these categories. The vertical axis is unlabeled, but it has a linear scale with no visible tick labels or units. Each category contains a group of four light green bars, with the height of the bars varying within each group. The "Decreasing" category has bars of increasing height from left to right, with the shortest bar having a value near the bottom of the axis and the tallest bar reaching about halfway up the axis. The "Spindle" category has bars with a more varied height, with the tallest bar being the second from the left and the shortest bar being the first from the left. The "Bottleneck" category is partially visible, but it appears to have a similar pattern to the other two categories. The bars within each group are not labeled or distinguished by different colors, but they are visually consistent within each category. Overall, the chart presents a comparison of the distribution of values across the three categories, with the bars within each category displaying distinct patterns.
